title: Razkadr slides
description: Layout engine output (naryad 021, ADR-0003): the Storyboard turned into slides with slots. Format-neutral: PPTX, HTML and PDF renderers build from this document. Deterministic: two runs on the same inputs produce byte-identical files.

schema_version.description: Slides schema version, semver (patch may be omitted). This schema validates major version 1 only.

lang.description: Language of the slide captions (heading texts like 'Ingredients'); episode text is never translated here (wave 3).

warnings.description: Document-level notes: unmapped roles and other non-fatal layout decisions. Nothing is dropped silently.

path.description: Frame image path, as recorded in the Storyboard.

t.description: Frame timestamp in seconds (from the Storyboard).

cell.description: One step cell of a steps_grid slide.

number.description: Global step number across the document, in Storyboard order.

text.description: Step text; empty when the episode has no text.

timecode.description: mm:ss or h:mm:ss of the episode t_start.

episode_id.description: Episode the warning is about (when applicable).

slot.description: Slot the text was truncated in (when applicable).

limit.description: Length limit that triggered the truncation.

layout.description: Layout name; the set of layouts is fixed by the engine, the role-to-layout mapping is configuration (naryad 021).

source_refs.description: Episode ids that feed this slide (continuation slides repeat the episode id).

slots.description: Slot values; which slots are present depends on the layout (see docs/layout.md). Slot keys are the union over layouts; the engine fills only the slots of its layout.

heading.description: Title heading (project title) or list heading ('Ingredients').

timecode.description: mm:ss or h:mm:ss of the episode t_start.

items.description: ingredients_list rows (split of the episode text).

columns.description: steps_grid: 2 means a 2x2 grid, 3 means three columns.
